text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while working in the trainer's 
office...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And gliding smooth and easy... we go.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. I really want some change after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Brother. Why don't we take a 
break from racing next time?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Sister. Why don't we take a 
break from racing next time?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren in races is great and all, but I 
wanna post different kinds of photos on 
Umastagram too. Like, for example—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Like a photo of us on a date, Big Brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Like photos of us on a date together♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is that a no? But I really want to 
boast to everyone that you're Curren's Big 
Brother... Please?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is that a no? But I really want to 
boast to everyone that you're Curren's Big 
Sister... Please?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Photos for Umastagram aside, I 
certainly have been a bit busy lately. 
Perhaps I should reconsider my upcoming 
schedule.
